body: Implemented SECTION 10 (EMILY PRIME SELENIUM / WEB AUDIT): auditFrontDoor() in emily-agent/webaudit.go runs the existing web_audit_url tool's auditURL against newssite (:8082) and signalapi (:9091 - corrected from the :8083 MJOLNIR's ProductsScreen displays, a pre-existing port discrepancy found during investigation and now documented in the tool description) with link-checking enabled. Gate: fail on 5xx status or >3 broken same-host links. Wired into runMorningBriefing (briefing.go) - the daily briefing push is what leads the user into MJOLNIR's WebView product screens, so it now runs the audit before firing; on failure the push is suppressed and an escalation Apple is filed instead, and today's send-sentinel is left unmarked so a later cron tick in the 08:30-09:30 UTC window can retry once the front door recovers. 5 new tests (webaudit_test.go) cover all-healthy, 5xx, exactly-3-vs-4 broken links, and unreachable-target cases. go build + go test green across all 6 go.work modules. Commit EMILY (emily-agent subtree).
title: S10-01: front-door audit gate before morning briefing push
